task.title: Web UI cleanup
task.description:
Some web UI fixes:
 - The Depends On/Blocks areas take up a lot of vertical space, find a way to compact them.
 - "Labels" input <label> is vertically centered, it should be vertically aligned to the top, in line with the input (chiclets below are additive)
 - Create more checkbox for new tasks should be above the save button, not right-aligned. The bottom footer is also too tall, there's a lot of extra padding around the buttons
